notes.text: Read-only analysis of completed R20 daily543 trace files. No model/API calls, no source/skill modifications, no additional experiment, and no evaluation actual arrays accessed.

Action availability and returned probabilities describe what was offered and chosen. Argmax probabilities are action preferences, not calibrated forecast confidence or evidence of hidden model motivation.

Per-origin current_forecast_comparison and latest historical diagnostic were checked against the actual API request. They are retained in this audit so absence of revisions cannot be attributed to their silent removal.

Zero optional input revisions means the observed run does not establish that iterative input revision improved forecasts. Initial proposal, retrieval and final selection can change outputs without using the revision loop.

Lower aggregate QS alone does not establish robust superiority: the root comparison also reports worse MAE and an improvement confidence interval crossing zero. This behavioral audit does not replace that paired evaluation.

The historical QS comparison covers only generated candidates on selected mature episodes. It does not establish which ungenerated configuration would be best, nor does historical argmin disagreement by itself establish an agent error.
